_about: Wild size derivation (List 22 #214) — the candidate answer to #161's single registered dependency, PROPOSED INTO #161's home: it lands only as an edit in #161's file citing this package. Until accepted there, the derivation is spec-level and instances nothing.
composition: measure(individual) = base(species) x factor(size_class(individual)) — composed per component if the species record's measurement lands as a height/weight pair
consumers: encounter presentation (the wild individual's presented scale)
#161 records — only when #161's own write rules fire
driver_argument: #80's size_class (small | standard | large, seed-derived) drives the factor — one roll drives many reads (#80's doctrine). A dedicated second size roll would make the same creature large to #43 and standard to the tape. #161's own dependency text names size_class as the candidate.

factor_shape.note: shape only — every numeric value is data-lane data, OPEN; no number is asserted anywhere in this package

open_slots: every species' base measurement (data lane — the audit's height/weight TBD, all species)
measure as one number vs a height/weight pair (#161's record shape carries the question)
persistence: the derived measure is encounter-transient, recomputed from the seed on demand. It becomes a #161 measurement FACT only at a keep (#38) or a contest presentation — #161's write rules, unchanged. A wild encounter ending without a keep produces no fact.
until_data_lands: with no species base measurements in existence, the derivation returns #161's specified honest empty state — no placeholder number, ever
